$comment: Auth rules every SDK shares: what a pasted token is, and the numbers and names the OAuth session uses. Source of truth for spec/03 Auth. Server behavior is in spec/01 (OAuth flows).

tokens.$comment: Checked at construction when a static token is given. Matched by prefix in this order. `refuse` throws a TypeError (or the language's argument error) with `message`; `warn` sends `message` to onWarning once and uses the token.

prefixes.message: That's an OAuth refresh token (hc_rt_…). Use the access token (hc_at_…) it came with, or exchange the refresh token for a new access token.
prefixes.why: Refresh tokens rotate. Exchanging the copy in the user's config spends it; the next run replays it and the API revokes the whole token family. Refresh tokens only live in an OAuth session's store.

prefixes.message: That's an OAuth authorization code (hc_ac_…). Exchange it at the token endpoint for an access token (hc_at_…) and use that.
Hardcover: this is a legacy JWT API key. It's deprecated and gets half the burst rate limit; create a personal access token (hc_pat_…) at hardcover.app → Account → API Access.

tokens.missingMessage: Hardcover token is missing. Pass a personal access token (hc_pat_…) or an OAuth access token (hc_at_…), e.g. from an environment variable that is actually set.

pkce.$comment: Random bytes before base64url encoding. 32 bytes gives a 43-character verifier, the RFC 7636 minimum.

refresh.$comment: Refresh when the access token has less than this left, so clock drift and a slow request don't send an expired token. Access tokens last a week; identity-only ones 15 minutes.
refresh.$retryComment: When a refresh inside that window fails at the token endpoint (offline, rate limited, down) and the access token hasn't expired, keep using it and try again after this long, or the server's Retry-After if longer. Never retried after invalid_grant.

device.$comment: RFC 8628. Defaults apply when the server omits the field. Each slow_down adds the increment to the interval for every later poll.

identityScopes.$comment: OpenID Connect scopes. profile, email and offline_access each imply openid. A grant made only of these gets a short-lived access token and no refresh token, unless it includes offline_access.

redirect.$comment: Parameters on the redirect back to the app. Read from the query; a fragment is ignored. iss (RFC 9207) must equal the environment's issuer when present and not empty. state must equal the attempt's.

signedOutReasons.revoked: The server refused the refresh token (invalid_grant): revoked on the website, re-authorization required, expired, or replayed.
signedOutReasons.expired: The access token expired and there is no refresh token (an identity-only grant).

tokenSet.$comment: How a session stores tokens: one JSON object under one key. Shared so stores and migrations look the same in every language. expiresAt is epoch milliseconds, computed from expires_in when the response arrives. scope is the space-separated string the server returned.

fields.expiresAt: number (epoch ms) | absent when the server sent no expires_in
